sloka: भ्रूणहत्याम् असि प्राप्ता कुलस्य अस्य विनाशनात् ।कैकेयि नरकम् गच्च मा च भर्तुः सलोकताम् ॥२-७४-४॥
transliteration: bhrūṇahatyām asi prāptā kulasya asya vināśanāt ।kaikeyi narakam gacca mā ca bhartuḥ salokatām ॥2-74-4॥

translations.english: O Kaikeyi by destroying this race you have earned the demerit of killing an embryo and shall enter hell. You shall never attain the same state of living, in the afterworld of your husband.
